why: Cold spec-judge round 1 returned oracle FAIL and builder FAIL. Oracle: the spec-producer node -- the file this CR revises and the one that defines the restored bar -- still carried its own Use Cases as a bare trigger/inputs/outcome table, so the CR failed to apply its own bar to the one behavioral node it revised. Swept the rule (a CR restoring a bar applies it to every node it revises): 5 revised nodes, 4 are spec-type reference and carry Subject rather than Use Cases, so the judge's single instance was the complete set. Builder: the Architect duty added here (the CFG reaches every stated extension) had no producer-side mirror, violating this repo's own mirrored-duty rule; swept the other two new bar duties and both were already mirrored, so again a single instance. Writing the node's own extensions then surfaced two further defects the bar caught on its author: a Clearance stop stated as an extension when it is the conductor's decision across a co-owned seam, and a forbidden combination (USER_INPUT with BACKFILL) that is a precedence rule the procedure never refuses -- naming it would have asserted a guard nothing tests, the exact defect this CR names. Both struck. Three stated extensions had no scenario and gained one.

Cold impl-judge round 1: all 16 frozen scenarios PASS and no scenario inert under a 7-mutant sentence-level sweep, but BLOCKER on an orthogonal structural read. The producer procedure re-listed the five recurring extension kinds as a flat imperative while the format bar, its node, the website page and this CR's own changeset all carry the criterion plus the not-a-closed-set hedge -- and it did so in the very step whose preamble warns that a hardcoded list drifts from the bar. Self-undermining, and invisible to all 16 scenarios since none tests a divergence outside the five named kinds. Swept every re-list site in the diff: five total, three already hedged, exactly the two operational sites the judge named were bare. Both now carry the criterion and the hedge and defer to the bar that owns it. Also closed the judge's observation that the reachable-graph scenario was instructed only by inference -- an explicit amend-neither-side sentence replaces the inference -- and aligned the extensions:none marker to its literal form.

Cold impl-judge round 2 returned IMPLEMENTATION_PASS true with no blocker, and corrected the arithmetic in my own round-1 remediation record. I reported the re-list sweep as five sites, three already hedged; the real count is six sites, four hedged, because the changeset carries the list too and my grep pattern missed it. The substantive work was right -- both bare operational sites were found and fixed, and the judge's independent sweep found no sixth bare site -- but the count as written is false and both the commit message and the prior log line carry it. Recording the correct figure here rather than leaving a provenance record a later audit would have to catch. Also closed the judge's one loose thread: the website page's at-a-glance table row listed four of the five kinds with no hedge, so it now states the criterion instead of a partial list.
